_about: A350-900, from Airbus AC A350 (Jul 01/26) 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions, A350-900 sheets 1 (side, front: page index 49) and 2 (plan: page index 50). Shaded pictures: layers.py --mode lines (the lines without the shading), line centres. The side sheet is scaled by its printed 65.26 m (nose to tail cone), which also puts the fin's tip at its printed 66.61 m; the plan sheet is drawn larger and is rendered at 7.41 to the same pixels a meter (its own 66.80 m and 46.68 m). Door 3 (over the wing; only its top is drawn) is placed from the door-location figure (2-7-0, page index 109: 37.93 m), which the drawn doors 1, 2 and 4 match within 4 cm. The windows behind the wing's lines are placed at the drawing's pitch.

sources.title: Airbus, A350 Aircraft Characteristics: Airport and Maintenance Planning (Jul 01/26), 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions (A350-900, sheets 1-2); 2-7-0 Door Location
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/a359/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The sheets are shaded pictures of about 41 pixels a meter, so the outlines are good to about 3 cm. Door 3, over the wing, is placed from the door-location figure; the windows behind the wing's lines at the drawing's pitch. The plan draws the tailplane about 2% wider than its printed 18.79 m span (the front view agrees with the print); the shape keeps the plan's.
